gap: Between cards the camera brushes past the previous card, which hangs as a flat out-of-focus cream slab across the right ~13% of the frame (v8.577, PetAid), so the next card's arrival is framed by a blank wall instead of the room and window.
notes: Strong mood: warm beams, dust, bright window, gobo on the floor all carry the golden hour into the dim room, and the cards are framed right of centre clear of the caption column at every named state. Still weak: (1) PetAid jumps from small at 8.577 to very large at 8.973, so it lands in a lurch instead of a gentle slow-down. (2) The beam/gloss haze veils the lower-left of the herbarium and lemon screenshots, so they read washed out next to SPEX. (3) Depth between the near card and the far cards is good, but the far stack is a pale clump with no light falloff. (4) The kacha, HaoJia and PetAid cards are type or illustration cards, not photos, so they read less like developed prints. No console errors or failed chapters.
